question.text: With reference to aqua regia, choose the correct option(s).

options.text: Reaction of gold with aqua regia produces <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> in the absence of air
Aqua regia is prepared by mixing conc. HCl and conc. HNO3 in 3 :1v/v ratio
Reaction of gold with aqua regia produces an anion having Au in +3 oxidation state

The yellow colour of <math><mi>a</mi><mi>q</mi><mi>u</mi><mi>a</mi><mi> </mi><mi>r</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>a</mi></math> is due to the presence of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>

solution.text:
Aqua regia is 3 past HCl and 1 part HNO3
3HCl+HNO2→NOCl+Cl2+2H2OYellow colour is due to NOCl and Cl2
Au+Aqua Regia→HAuCl4+3 O.S of Au
